appDesc.message: Detects and downloads video and audio from web pages: direct files, HLS (m3u8), DASH (mpd) and MSE player recording.

perm_banner.message: The extension doesn't have permission to access websites, so it can't detect videos.

blocked_banner.message: This extension doesn't work on this site.

drm_banner.message: DRM-protected content{1}. Videos encrypted with DRM (Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay) can't be downloaded.

yt_banner.message: YouTube delivers video in signed fragments that can't be downloaded directly. Use the MSE recording below or copy a yt-dlp command.

empty_list.message: No videos detected yet. Play the video on the page and open this menu again.

name_title.message: Name the file will be saved as. Click to change it.

ytdlp_title.message: Copy a command to download with yt-dlp from the terminal

toast_pickTrack.message: Choose at least video or audio

toast_started.message: Download started. Follow its progress in "Downloads".

toast_recSent.message: Recording sent to "Downloads". Don't close or reload this tab until it finishes.

mse_helpArmed.message: Whatever the player loads is saved. Set a fixed quality in the site's player (not "Auto") and play the video to the end (you can speed it up); avoid seeking backwards.

mse_help.message: Last resort for sites that build the video with JavaScript (blob:). Records the fragments as they play. Doesn't work with DRM content.

manager_note.message: Downloads keep going even if you close this tab. The history is kept until you close the browser.

manager_empty.message: No downloads in this session. Open the extension menu on a page with a video.

file_missing.message: The file no longer exists or was moved.

set_minSize.message: Hide files smaller than (MB, 0 = show everything)

set_convert.message: Convert .ts / fMP4 streams to MP4 (no re-encoding)

job_interrupted.message: Interrupted: the extension restarted during the download. Retry it.

job_askRecording.message: Requesting the recording from the page…

job_muxingAV.message: Joining video and audio with ffmpeg…

log_live.message: Live stream: only what's currently available in the playlist is downloaded.

log_qualityChanged.message: The player changed quality during the recording: the longest part is kept and {1} are discarded. To avoid this, set a fixed quality in the site's player (not "Auto") and use "Record from the start".

log_muxFailed.message: Couldn't join ({1}). Video and audio are saved separately.

log_convertFailed.message: Couldn't convert ({1}); the original file is saved.

err_drmStream.message: This stream is DRM-protected and can't be downloaded.

err_drmVideo.message: This video is DRM-protected and can't be downloaded.

err_drmAudio.message: This audio is DRM-protected and can't be downloaded.

err_noSegments.message: Couldn't compute the video segments (live stream?).

err_noTracks.message: The MPD has no downloadable tracks.

err_noRecording.message: No recorded data on that page (was the tab closed or reloaded?).
